text:
Maria: quick heads-up — running new model bringup (redwood-beta-1) with int8 quant + longprime sequence test (64k window). seeing intermittent mismatch after prefill + roll-forward.

Ashwin: can you paste the minimal repro?

Maria: steps: prefill ~48k tokens, resume with ~5k tokens streaming. sometimes tokens 47,998-48,002 duplicate or garbled. reproduces ~1/20 runs.

Maria: logs snapshot: ```
[kv] prefill end idx=48000 next_write=48005 kv_index=47998 assert_ok=0
```

Ben: did you try disabling prefix KV caching?

Maria: yes — when `prefill_cache=false` the issue disappears. suspect index wrap or stride replay.

Sasha: is this only on int8 or also fp16?

Maria: fp16 seems clean. int8 shows noise, int4 is worse.

Ashwin: may be RoPE phase wrap. Which RoPE scaling scheme are you using?

Maria: using `rotary_scale_linear_v2` per model config.

Kai: can you dump kv index mapping from GPU? `dump_kv_index --range 47990-48010` would help.

Maria: uploaded dump to artifacts: https://redwood.internal/a/ART-2345 ; key snippet: ```
kv[47998] -> shard0_offset=15, global_pos=47998
```

Ben: looks like a jitter during shard join. were you running multi-shard inference?

Maria: yes, 2xA100 with sequence sharding. single-shard runs look fine.

Sasha: could be quant memcpy padding changing alignment; int packing can shift indices if rounding to byte boundaries.

Ashwin: can you open a ticket? I'll try to run the reproducer on local dev rig (cpu fallback / single-gpu) to triage.

Maria: opened INC-3421 and pushed a repro script. run id 2026-03-19T09:12. tagging @ashwin @ben @sasha.

Kai: quick ask — add a small matrix: toggle `rotary_scale=false` and `rotary_scale=static` in the config and record failures.

Maria: done. results so far: `rotary_scale=false` -> stable; `rotary_scale=static` -> unstable (~1/8 runs fail).

Ben: interesting — could be an interaction between quant scale clamp and RoPE interpolation. I'll prototype injecting a tiny epsilon on KV writes and see if it stabilizes indices.

Ashwin: also add a CI flaky-run harness (random seeds) so we get a failure distribution.

Maria: added `ci/eng-ml/kv-sanity.sh` with 50 repeats. current counts: fp16=0 fails, int8=4 fails, int4=12 fails.

Sasha: ok. next steps: Ben to prototype epsilon fix; Kai to verify sharded aggregator indices; Ashwin to run 200-repeat CI job; Maria to run extended 120k-token overnight job.

Maria: pinging for visibility :eyes: 

infra-bot: deploy completed to staging at 2176543300 :white_check_mark:

Maria: thanks — will report back tomorrow.
